description: Executable predeclared numerical qualification of the native centered hierarchical TruncatedNormal group-location priors proposed in HSSM #1269.

smoke.description: Cheap construction, initialization, log-density, gradient, and short-chain screening.

stress.description: Adverse-geometry and target_accept sensitivity diagnostics that cannot rescue a failed primary gate.

analysis_policy.fixed_recovery_bias_policy: absolute-mean-standardized-error-only; five-replicate sign tests are descriptive

fixed_truth_sequence: draw group coefficients from fixed_group_values using group_seed
sbc_truth_sequence: draw group_location from the candidate TruncatedNormal location prior using truth_seed
draw group_scale as 0.3*numpy_generator.weibull(1.5) using the same truth_seed stream after group_location
draw group coefficients from TruncatedNormal(group_location,group_scale,scenario bounds) using group_seed
data_generation.softmax_beta: response=1 iff U<expit(group_value), else -1, with U from observation_seed
data_generation.zero_observation_semantics: n_per_group=0 omits the observed likelihood and retains n_groups latent group coefficients
data_generation.sbc_posterior_use: all retained draws feed posterior summaries; only rank computation uses the frozen selected 100 draws

paired_execution.scope: qualification candidate/control pairs with calibration_kind null
paired_execution.placement: same physical worker for both members of one replicate pair
paired_execution.order: candidate then control for even replicates; control then candidate for odd replicates
paired_execution.isolation: each member runs in its own fresh process with unique phase-local PyTensor and JAX caches
paired_execution.timing: both members use the identical frozen timing scope
paired_execution.failure: attempt both members and publish an independent final cell marker for each
paired_execution.provenance: one parent-minted pair_execution_id and worker_identity_sha256 are shared; distinct execution_attempt_id values and parity-ordered pair_position values are embedded in the two final cell records

execution_policy.phase_provenance: sample and finalize accept only a parent-minted checksummed context binding phase, cell, execution identity, and exact fresh phase-local cache paths

initialization_policies.backend-default: use the explicit start_seeds; call make_initial_point_fns_per_chain once with every free RV jittered; pass those exact transformed starts with adapt_diag
initialization_policies.hssm-default: seed and restore legacy NumPy with initialization_seed while HSSM performs constrained preprocessing and support-aware jitter; transform the resulting _initvals once with no additional jitter; replicate that identical transformed start across chains and pass it with adapt_diag

seed_execution.start_seeds: backend-default only: derive_start_seed(initialization_seed,cell_id,replicate,chain_index) for every chain; hssm-default records an empty list and consumes initialization_seed exactly once while constructing _initvals
seed_execution.pymc: chain_seeds has length chains and is passed verbatim as random_seed; sampler_seed is null; effective_numpyro_chain_keys is null
seed_execution.numpyro: chain_seeds is empty; scalar sampler_seed is passed to sample_numpyro_nuts; effective key is PRNGKey(sampler_seed) for one chain or jax.random.split(PRNGKey(sampler_seed),chains) otherwise; record every resulting two-uint32 key in effective_numpyro_chain_keys

artifact_policy.data_artifact: canonical strict JSON containing scenario-independent truth, group values, observations, and all DGP seeds; shared writers must verify identical bytes

chain_variable_scales.group_scale: prior-native (response for truncated_normal; linear_predictor for linked_normal)

artifact_policy.group_effect_dimension: group coordinate is the zero-based group index in data-artifact order and has exactly scenario.n_groups entries
artifact_policy.failure_semantics: data is retained after successful generation; start is retained only after successful initialization; chain is retained only after successful sampling and validation; cell result is always the final atomic completion marker and names absent artifacts as null; discard partial temporary files
